help_summary: Keep your program shortcuts together with names, descriptions and manuals so you remember what each one is.
help_howto:
• In Explorer, right-click > New > 'Shortcut list' to create a list, then double-click it to open.
• Click + or drop shortcuts and programs onto the window to add them.
• Double-click a row to run it. Use the pencil button to edit or delete.
• Rows with a manual, web address or memo show an icon on the right.
• Choose custom order in the sort menu to drag the handle on the left and reorder.
• Set another list (.sbook) as a target to nest lists like folders.
